personality_one_liner: A calm, trustworthy, and frictionless patient experience pairing classic dental blue aesthetics with modern iOS-native readability and whitespace.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythms. Content must never touch the edges. Use md/lg spacing for list margins, avoid cramped items.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on sticky headers above scrolling lists.
Use for featured booking cards over background images.
dont's: Do not use on regular form inputs or basic list rows.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Frictionless authentication using Google Auth or guest mode to avoid drop-off.

states.error: Failed login toast or inline error.

screens.layout: Full-height view, clean dental interior blurred background or soft gradient, clinic logo wordmark, 'Entrar com Google' button using brand colors.

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub for next appointments, live booking, and quick access to services.

states.loading: Skeleton of the next appointment card and service tiles.
states.empty: Illustration of a calendar with 'Nenhuma consulta agendada', primary CTA to book.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data, retry button.

screens.layout: Split-grid layout. Hero section with live 'Next Appointment' booking module featuring time-slot chips. Content bands for 'Our Services' (horizontal scroll tiles) and 'Dr. Jocélio' (doctor profile snippet). Sticky bottom tabs.

screens.name: BookingFlow

states.empty: No slots available for the selected day, show calendar to pick another.

screens.layout: Modular scheduling interface. Step 1: Service selection. Step 2: Date/Time grid (15-min increments). Step 3: Booking review summary. Bottom sticky CTA for 'Confirmar Agendamento'.

screens.name: Appointments
screens.purpose: History of past visits and upcoming appointments.

states.empty: 'Você ainda não tem consultas agendadas.' with an icon and CTA to book.

screens.layout: Segmented control (Próximas / Histórico). List items with date, time, service name, and dentist. Use glassmorphism on the sticky segment header.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Patient medical/dental records and account settings.
screens.layout: Avatar (initials if no image) and patient details. List of menu options (Meus Registros, Galeria Antes/Depois, Contato, Sair). Clean settings-style rows with right chevrons.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: Clinic management for appointments and patients.
screens.layout: Command-center style but clean. List of today's appointments with swipe-to-confirm or swipe-to-cancel actions. Quick stats at the top.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Use rounded, humanist typography (Plus Jakarta Sans) and generous padding to avoid a cluttered or 'clinical' look.
Implement a bottom tab navigation with 4 tabs: Home, Agendamentos, Perfil, and Admin (hidden for regular patients).
Design the Home dashboard using a split-grid layout with a prominent, live 'Next Appointment' booking module featuring time-slot chips to reduce friction.
The primary action in the Booking flow must be a sticky bottom button inside a KeyboardAvoidingView/fixed footer so it's always accessible without scrolling.
The color palette uses classic dental blue (#1A73E8) and white to evoke trust and cleanliness, explicitly satisfying the user's request and overriding the 'no blue' rule.
Always apply gradient-to-dark scrims (Layer 1) before overlaying any text onto background images (e.g., in the Login or Hero sections) to guarantee readability (WCAG AA).
For the admin panel, prioritize a clean 'command center' feel with swipeable list rows for quick actions (confirm/cancel).
Ensure all interactive elements (chips, booking slots, buttons) meet a minimum 44x44pt touch target.
